authorship: Expected observations and task wording authored from the incident investigation requirements before any benchmark feedback. No catalog, skill, or graph import generates expectations.

deployment.interpretation: Error rate exceeds its baseline and the current deployment changed retry configuration at the same time. This is a simulated correlation, with a rollback candidate, and no write occurs.

provider.interpretation: Current provider-reported component status and unresolved incidents are both required. No particular status or incident count is expected, and provider reports do not diagnose our application.
